definitions.explanation: An educational system where students study primarily at home through mail, online resources, or periodic in-person sessions rather than attending school daily.

examples.japanese: {通信制|つうしんせい}の{高校|こうこう}に{通|かよ}っている。
examples.english: I attend a correspondence high school.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}をしながら{通信制|つうしんせい}{大学|だいがく}で{学|まな}んでいる。
examples.english: I am studying at a correspondence university while working.

examples.japanese: {通信制|つうしんせい}は{自分|じぶん}のペースで{勉強|べんきょう}できるのが{利点|りてん}だ。
examples.english: The advantage of distance learning is that you can study at your own pace.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly used as a modifier before educational institutions: {通信制|つうしんせい}{高校|こうこう} (correspondence high school) and {通信制|つうしんせい}{大学|だいがく} (correspondence university). Japan has a well-established system of {通信制|つうしんせい} schools.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通信制|つうしんせい}{高校|こうこう} (correspondence high school)
- {通信制|つうしんせい}{大学|だいがく} (correspondence university)
- {通信制|つうしんせい}の{課程|かてい} (correspondence course)

RELATED WORDS:
- {全日制|ぜんにちせい}: full-time (school) system
- {定時制|ていじせい}: part-time (evening) school system
